book.name: Maak
book.title: Pwoo ɗeret nKaa Jesu Kristi Ɗe Maak

content: Jesu Sat SǝmpwoonKaa nGuɓwet4.1 ko fwoo. Cirem

Jesu waa baa yaa kám-kam ɗe ngurum mo mpwoo am kuur nǝ. Ɓe gurum mo ɗes mo jì kuur pee wur ɗi. Mbe ɗuu kǝ gurum nǝ mo, ɓe Jesu ɗel tong nɗǝǝn tii nkaa am nǝ, ɓe ɗuu kǝ gurum nǝ mo jì ɗar pǝkom am kuur nǝ.
Jesu kám mbii mo ngurum mo ɗes shi sǝmpwoo mo. Nɗǝǝn kám wur nǝ mo, ɓe wur sat mmo nǝnee,
<<wu lekom! Gyet mee ngumaar wur put dǝm mɓe ɓwet cirem mɓut mmaar.
Ɓe kaaɗi wur nkaa ɓwet cirem nǝ, ɓe pak cirem nǝ mo taa nkaa ar, ɓe nyer mo sham cak cirem nǝ se.
Pak cirem nǝ mo taa nkaa kwoop, a peeɗi baa nǝ kǝ yil ɗes kas. Abet, ɓe cirem nǝ mo ciir kàa.
Kaaɗe puuskàa ɓe mo caan har mo fii, mbǝɗe baa mo kat yil ɗes mbe sham seen kas.
Pak cirem nǝ mo taa mɓut nhǝr mo, ɓe mo kàa wurang nɗǝǝn hǝr nǝ mo, ɓe hǝr nǝ mo tǝreng káa mmo, ɓe baa mo le mee aa kas.
Pak cirem nǝ mo taa nkaa yil ɗeret, ɓe mo kàa wurang rǝret, kǝ mo le àa ɗes. Memee le àa mo laarkun, kǝ memee le mo laarpeemee, kǝ memee le mo kambil.>>
Jesu sat nǝnee, <<Ngwar ɗewur kǝ koom mǝ kǝlǝngpee, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ wur kǝlǝng.>>
Jesu Leshap nGurumMo Shi Sǝmpwoo
Kaaɗe Jesu ɗee mbǝshin, ɓe pak nen ɗe mo kǝlǝng sǝmpwoo nǝ, mo jì ashak kǝ jeplep wur ɗe ɗekaapaat baavǝl sǝ mo. Mo jì tal pǝ wur, mbǝkǝ wur sat shii Sǝmpwoo nǝ ɗi mmo.
Jesu sat mmo nǝ, <<Naan shin man nwun, mbǝkǝ wur manshii kǝ mbii ɗe mo a sǝsok mǝ mulki Naan, amma pee nen ɗe atǝlǝng mo, ɓe moo kǝlǝng mbii ɗesǝ mo jir a shi sǝmpwoo.
Mbǝkǝ koo

content.text: <ɗe mo naa, ɓe mon nnaa shi yit ɗak,
amma baa mon nnaashii nǝ kas.
ɓe mon nkǝlǝng a shi kom ɗak,
amma baa mon mmanshii nǝ kas,
kǝ Naan fwo shikbish fur mo ɗi.>>

content: Shii Kǝ SǝmpwoonKaa Fwo Cirem Ni
Jesu tal pǝ mo nǝnee, <<Baa wuu manshii sǝmpwoo ɗesǝ nǝ kas aa? Cinarang ɗang wun mmanshii kǝ koor sǝmpwoo nǝ mo yi?
Shii kǝ sǝmpwoo nǝ nɗesi, ngumaar nǝ wur a kaa ngusatpwoo Naan sǝ.
Pak gurum mo a kaa cirem ɗe mo taa a ar sǝ, ɗe katɗang mo kǝlǝng pwoo Naan nǝ, ɓe abet, ngujwaan wur jì ghǝr pwoo ɗe mo kǝlǝng nǝ nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fur mo.
Pak gurum mo a kaa cirem ɗe mo ɓwet a kwoop sǝ, ɗe katɗang mo kǝlǝng pwoo kǝ Naan ni, ɓe mo lap shi retnyit kǝlak-kǝlak.
Amma baa nǝ sham seen jurum-jurum, nɗǝǝn mo kas, kǝ baa mon nteer vǝl kas. Katɗang mee luk yool koo gurum mo shin jeel mmo, mbe pwoo Naan nǝ, ɓe abet, mo baa shiɓwoon kǝlak-kǝlak.
Pak gurum mo a kaa cirem ɗe mo taa mɓut nghǝr mo sǝ, ɗe katɗang mo kǝlǝng pwoo Naan nǝ,
ɓe, mbe pan kǝ mbii mo, kǝ choor long mǝ yil ɗesǝ mo, kǝ numpee mǝ long mo, kǝ fwoot mǝ pak mbii mo, mo vwan pwoo nǝ, ɓe baa mo làa-làa kas.

Pak gurum mo a kaa cirem ɗe mo ɓwet mo nkaa yil ɗeret sǝ, ɗe mo kǝlǝng pwoo Naan nǝ. Ɓe mo lap nǝ, ɓe pwoo Naan nǝ cìn ɗak ɗes nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fur mo, kaa cirem ɗe nǝ làa-làa mo ɗes sǝ. Pak mo làa-làa laarkun, pak mo laarpeemee kǝ pak mo kambil.>>
Wus zukpaal Ɗe MoPaa Shi Ɗaa Ɗǝɗes
Jesu sat mmo nǝnee, <<Kyet mee gurum nle wus nfitila, ɗang wur waa mang ɗaa ɗeɗes paa nǝ ɗi wa? Koo wur waa le nǝ nder peesaam wa? Amma wur nle nǝ aɗeng pee, a pee le fitila.
Baa mee mbii ɗe, ɗe nǝ a sǝsok ɗe nǝn nook put agaak kas, kǝ baa mee mbii ɗe, ɗe nǝ a pǝpaa, ɗe mon nook put kǝ nǝ agaak kas.
Ngwar ɗewur kǝ kom mǝ kǝlǝngpee, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ wur kǝleng.>>
Wur sat mmo zak nǝnee, <<Wu cìn pan nkaa mbii ɗe wuu kǝlǝng mo. Shi ɗaa ɗe wuu kám mbii ɗe ngurum mo, ɓe mon nkám mbii mo wun a shi shik zak, ɓe nǝn ngam met mumo nǝ zak.
Koo ɗang weyi ɗewur kǝ mbii, ɓe mon ncin ɗyikǝ nwur. Ɗangɓe gwar ɗe baa wur kǝ mee mbii kas, ɓe mon nsǝǝt nwaa yaa wur kǝ rep mbii ɗewur kǝ nǝ.>>
Sǝmpwoo Mǝ Cirem Ɗe Nii Kàa
Jesu sat zak nǝnee, <<Mulki Naan nǝ a kaa mee gwar ɗe wu ɓwet cirem ɗǝɓen mɓut mmaar sǝ.
Ɓe wur saam mpar, kǝ wur yool mbít, ɓe ɗǝɓen nii kàa nii wurang. Ɓe baa wur man kaaɗi nii wurang sǝ kas.
Yil nǝ shikáa wur, nii kǝ le mbii kǝkop mo kaa làa-làa. Nshee, ɓe nǝ wurang kàa pyan kom, ɓe nǝ putkáa, kǝ nǝ le àa.
Kaaɗe ɗǝɓen nǝ nung, ɓe wur mang cuk dǝm ɗiip ɗǝɓen nǝ abet, mbǝɗe pee mak ɗiip nǝ.>>
Jesu Sat SǝmpwoonKaa Rep àas Mustad
Jesu sat nǝnee, <<Mun nkám mulki Naan nǝ a kaa me sǝ yi? Kǝ mun nkám nǝ a shi sǝmpwoo ɗeɗangyii?
Nǝ a kaa àas kǝ mee tǝng, ɗe moo pet nǝ a mustad sǝ, ɗe nǝ kat met àas kǝ cirem mo jir, ɗang ɓe katɗang mo kop nǝ nyil,
ɓe nǝ yool wurang, ɓe nǝ ɗee a tǝng ɗeɗes zam. Nii put song ɗenan-nan mo, ɓe nyer mo jì le tish fur mo mɓut riin ni.>>
Jesu satpwoo ngurum mo, nkaa mulki kǝ Naan shi sǝmpwoo mo shini-shini, kaaɗi mo mak manshii nǝ sǝ.
Baa Jesu satpwoo ngurum nǝ mo kas, see a shi sǝmpwoo mo. Ɗang be katɗang wur ɗee mbǝshin ashak kǝ jeplep nwur mo, ɓe wur tap yakshii sǝmpwoo nǝ mmo jir.
Jesu Le Kǝ Kut Ni Ɗok Tǝtǝk
Parpuus mǝnǝ, nkansǝǝn, ɓe Jesu sat njeplep fin mo nǝnee, <<Wu yool mmun, kǝ mu canɗel mu dǝm nkor ɗesí.>>
Mo yool yit ɗuu gurum nǝ mo, ɓe mo dǝm ashak kǝ Jesu nɗǝǝn tii ɗewur tong nɗǝǝn nǝ. Pak tii nǝ mo yool dǝm nɗang wur zak.
Mee kut ɗeɗes nǝ yool nkaa am nǝ, ɓe am ɗel nɗǝǝn tii nǝ. Ɓe tii nǝ ɗoom gam kǝ am.
Ɗangbe Jesu nsaam mɓwoon nɗǝǝn tii nǝ. Ɓe jeplep wur mo dǝm mii wur. Mo sat nǝ, <<Ngukám, a naa mun murep mbǝsǝ kas aa?>>
Jesu wur mii, ɓe wur gwak kut nǝ, ɓǝ wur sat am kuur nǝ nǝnee, <<A ɗok tǝtǝk. A saam coot.>> Ɓe kut nǝ ɗar, pee ɗokshik tǝtǝk.
Jesu sat njeplep wur mo nǝnee, <<A me le ɗang kǝǝrmuut yaa wun ye? Har yaksǝ, ɓe baa wun shinzeen kas aa?>>
Nǝ aapwoo mmo ɗes zam, ɓe mo sat nshak nǝnee, <<Gwar ɗesǝ wur a weye? Ɗe har kut kǝ am kuur, mo cìn nɗyen wur!>>
